item.title: Codex Skills System
item.description:
OpenAI Codex’s built-in skills system discovers SKILL.md skills from ~/.codex/skills/ and installs new ones via $skill-installer, either from OpenAI’s curated catalog or any GitHub repo.

Why a skill for this

Having a first-party install path and curated catalog, rather than only community-assembled lists, is what makes a skills ecosystem practical to actually adopt inside Codex.

item.title: OpenAI Skills/Plugins Catalog
item.description:
This is OpenAI’s official, curated repository of Codex skills and plugins — covering design tools, testing, security, observability, and one-command cloud deploys.

Why a skill for this

A first-party curated catalog is a stronger trust signal than an assembled community list — these skills are maintained by, or reviewed by, OpenAI itself rather than crowdsourced without a review bar.

item.title: Skill Creator (OpenAI)
item.description:
This system skill, auto-installed with Codex, scaffolds a new SKILL.md-compliant skill from a plain description of what it should do.

Why a skill for this

Getting a skill’s folder structure and frontmatter right by hand is easy to get subtly wrong. A scaffolding skill means authoring a new skill starts from a correct template instead of a blank file.
